title: Moderate Deviations for Nonlinear Hawkes Processes
summary: A Hawkes process is a simple point process whose intensity depends on its history; the resulting dynamics are generally non-Markovian. We establish a sample-path moderate deviation principle for a nonlinear Hawkes process in the full moderate regime. Since a Poisson cluster representation is unavailable for nonlinear Hawkes processes, we use the past configuration as a Markov state and construct a potential, or Poisson corrector, for the centered stochastic intensity.
